```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(here)
source(here("scripts", "01_packages.R"))
source(here("scripts", "02b_definedelays.R"))
source(here("R", "funcs_plots.R"))
source(here("R", "funcs_data.R"))
source(here("R", "generate_scores_func.R"))
source(here("R", "lshtm_theme.R"))
source(here("R", "plots_baseline.R"))
source(here("scripts", "datacollect.R"))
library(patchwork)
```

```{r load_and_score}
disease <- "ebola"

# Get start date for filtering
startdate <- startenddates[[disease]]$startdate

# Load resim data
resim_data <- read_latest(here("data"), paste0(disease, "_sim_data"))

# Load resim forecasts
resim_samples <- read_latest(here("results/sim"),
  paste0("res_", disease, "_resim_latest_all_samples"))
resim_id <- read_latest(here("results/sim"),
  paste0("res_", disease, "_resim_latest_all_id"))
resim_R <- read_latest(here("results/sim"),
  paste0("res_", disease, "_resim_latest_all_R"))

# Load actual disease Rt trajectory as truth
rt_resim <- readRDS(here("data", paste0("rt_", disease, ".rds")))
if ("median" %in% names(rt_resim)) {
  rt_resim <- rt_resim |> select(date, median) |> rename(R = median)
} else {
  rt_resim <- rt_resim |> select(date, R)
}
rt_resim <- rt_resim |> mutate(scen = "resim",
                               rt_traj = "resim",
                               rt_opts = "latest",
                               ur = "y")

resim_samples <- resim_samples |> filter(date <= as.Date(startdate) + 6*4*7)
resim_R <- resim_R |> filter(date <= as.Date(startdate) + 6*4*7)

# Score
scores_cases_resim <- generate_scores_cases(resim_samples, resim_id, resim_data) |>
  mutate(scen = "resim", rt_opts = "latest", rt_traj = "resim", ur = "y")
scores_rt_resim <- generate_scores_rt(resim_R, resim_id, rt_resim) |>
  mutate(scen = "resim", rt_opts = "latest", rt_traj = "resim", ur = "y")
```

## Full Rt plots

```{r timeseries_r, echo=FALSE}
rtplot_resim <- plot_baseline_rt(resim_R, resim_id, rt_resim,
                                 scores_rt_resim, 4)
ggsave(here("figures", paste0("rtresimplot_", disease, ".png")),
       rtplot_resim$final_plot, width = 13.5, height = 8.5)

rtbaselineplot_resim <- list(
  barchart_mean_gen_time = rtplot_resim$barchart_mean_gen_time,
  barchart_mean_inc_period = rtplot_resim$barchart_mean_inc_period
)
rm(rtplot_resim); gc()
```

```{r timeseries_cases, echo=FALSE}
caseplot_resim <- plot_baseline_cases(resim_samples, resim_id, resim_data,
                                      scores_cases_resim, 4)
ggsave(here("figures", paste0("caseresimplot_", disease, ".png")),
       caseplot_resim$final_plot, width = 13.5, height = 8.5)

casebaselineplot_resim <- list(
  barchart_mean_gen_time = caseplot_resim$barchart_mean_gen_time,
  barchart_mean_inc_period = caseplot_resim$barchart_mean_inc_period,
  timeseries = caseplot_resim$timeseries
)
rm(caseplot_resim, resim_samples, resim_R, resim_id, resim_data); gc()
```

```{r combining_heatmaps, echo=FALSE}
rt_barchartgentime_resim <- rtbaselineplot_resim$barchart_mean_gen_time + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size=20))
rt_barchartincperiod_resim <- rtbaselineplot_resim$barchart_mean_inc_period + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size=20))
case_barchartgentime_resim <- casebaselineplot_resim$barchart_mean_gen_time + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size=20))
case_barchartincperiod_resim <- casebaselineplot_resim$barchart_mean_inc_period + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size=20))

## Combine timeseries
casetimeseries_resim <- casebaselineplot_resim$timeseries + ggtitle("Resim")
```
